metadata.title: Infrastructure reliability incident investigation
metadata.artifact_scope_note: Evidence is aggregated query output (not raw log lines or metric samples); it contains no chat/communication records.

incident_description: Reliability incident investigation of a production environment. Evidence consists of Elasticsearch aggregation results over application and proxy logs, Kubernetes, cloud-provider and host system events, Prometheus Alertmanager alerts, change-management / CI-CD audit records and metric anomaly detection. No root cause, impact or trigger is stated; these must be established from the supplied artifacts. Environment context: Organization: Falconvid Logistics (freight and logistics); Platform: AWS us-west-2 (zones us-west-2a/us-west-2b/us-west-2c/us-west-2d); network range 10.239.0.0/16; Kubernetes cluster falcon-prod-uswest (EKS); Edge: provider-managed load balancer (edge-lb) in front of portal-bff backends; a standby load balancer exists in a secondary region; Change management: production changes carry CR- identifiers.
investigation_questions: What load balancer error detail was logged for most failed requests?
During what hour did the first signs of the failure appear? Provide the earliest date and time in YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM UTC format.

What is the root cause category of the incident: configuration change, software defect, hardware failure, cloud provider failure, capacity exhaustion, automation error, certificate expiry, or third-party dependency failure?
Which of the three CIA components is primarily affected: availability, integrity, or confidentiality?
According to the error volume statistics, what single service emitted the most errors? Is it the root cause or a downstream symptom?
Which change restored normal service? Provide its change identifier.
